composition_subtypes.role: Sort pencils by saturation to enable contiguous grouping
Precompute max window size within d for each start index
Use heap to manage valid segment intervals and greedily chain boxes

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort; precompute window sizes via two-pointers; then sweep with priority queue to decide if boxes can cover all pencils.
payload.rationale: Sorting enables linear window computation. Two-pointer amortized O(n). Heap-based sweep implements greedy decision to chain minimum-size segments.
